name: Coalition Acrobat
description: An elastic deal-maker who can oppose both sides and still arrive for the signing ceremony.

comebacks.weak: Your promise is already out of season.
comebacks.medium: I wear my principles inside out. You left yours in the changing room.
comebacks.strong: You brought a red line to a negotiation. I brought an eraser.
